message: The other night, we lost power during a storm, and I could hear my friend Sarah in the next room starting to panic. I calmly pulled out my trusty flashlight and power bank, reminded her to charge her phone, and set up our little lantern for some cozy light. It turned into a fun game instead of a disaster! Sometimes, all it takes is a little preparedness to turn a blackout into a bonding moment. How do you keep calm when the lights go out?
